source.gives: Pelican: a one-piece glass alembic with two beaks returning condensate, little used by the late 1700s; retort is a long-necked flask; Le Febure Traite de Chimie 1646/1660 and French's Art of Distillation (publication year not stated, open); no date for the first glass still found (open)
